title: Judging others
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
Parable of the wooden beam in one's eye.
The outer correspondence is prohibitions about evaluation and values. The former is problem about low evaluation against people. The latter is problem about high evaluation against objects. In both cases, people should realize self imperfection and should not stick to one's evaluation
